title: One-loop $p$-adic string theory and the Néron local height function
summary: The $p$-adic string worldsheet action on the quotient of the Bruhat-Tits tree of $PGL(2,\mathbb{Q}_p)$ by a genus 1 Schottky group has a dual description on the asymptotic boundary, the Tate curve $\mathbb{Q}_p^\ast/q^\mathbb{Z}$. We show that the two point function of the dual action coincides with the Néron-Tate local height function of the Tate curve.
